Patient Case Studies

Case 01 Cosmetic Bonding

Great Single-Visit Results for a Skeptical, Frustrated Patient

Recently, a new patient came into Walden Dental to see Dr. Frank for some cosmetic dental work. Jen was frustrated and discouraged with previous dental experiences because the bonding work provided would only last a few hours before failing. When Jen walked in for her appointment with Dr. Frank, she made it known that she needed the work done within a single visit. Dr. Frank and his staff accepted this challenge and set to accomplish this goal. Despite Jen’s cynicism, she came in for her virtual smile consult, where Dr. Frank and his staff showed her the possibilities that could be achieved with a promise that it could be done in just a few hours.

They showed me the possibilitiesand delivered. In just a few hours, I had the smile I’d been chasing for years. Patient Story
Case 02 Tooth Restoration

Broken Tooth Restored in a Single Visit And She Loves It

Jen came into Walden Dental with a broken tooth. She had visited an after-hours clinic previously but never got the results she was hoping for the restoration, which was supposed to last until she could see a dentist, popped off within 20 minutes. This left her skeptical and doubtful that any dentist could deliver the results she was seeking, let alone within a single appointment. A friend referred Jen to Walden Dental, where Dr. Frank and his team employ the latest in dental technologies. Within a single appointment, Jen had her broken tooth fixed and she loves the work! Jen cannot thank Dr. Frank enough for her newly restored smile.

One appointment. One restored smile. Jen cannot thank Dr. Frank enough. Patient Story
